lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: Ik▫oaⁿkaar sat naam karṯaa purakẖ nirbẖa▫o nirvair akaal mooraṯ ajoonee saibẖaⁿ gur parsaaḏ.
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace.
True In The Primal Beginning. True Throughout The Ages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਸੀ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: Hai bẖī sacẖ Nānak hosī bẖī sacẖ. ||1||
lines.translation: True Here And Now. O Nanak, Forever And Ever True. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਚੈ ਸੋਚਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸੋਚੀ ਲਖ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: Socẖai socẖ na hova▫ī je socẖī lakẖ vār.
lines.translation: By Thinking, He Cannot Be Reduced To Thought, Even By Thinking Hundreds Of Thousands Of Times.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੁਪੈ ਚੁਪ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਲਾਇ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: Cẖupai cẖup na hova▫ī je lā▫e rahā liv ṯār.
lines.translation: By Remaining Silent, Inner Silence Is Not Obtained, Even By Remaining Lovingly Absorbed Deep Within.
